title: poidh txs per day dashboard
description:
launch a simple dashboard that shows aggregate transactions per day across these 3 contracts 

Ethereum Mainnet - https://etherscan.io/address/0xe731dfadbff20542e10d09d26fc71445c70d4232

Arbitrum - https://arbiscan.io/address/0x5555fa783936c260f77385b4e153b9725fef1719

Base - https://basescan.org/address/0x5555fa783936c260f77385b4e153b9725fef1719

should have history that goes back to Jan 1 2026 and it should automatically update each day

first legit claim wins 🏆

winningClaim.title: poidh txs per day: live hosted dashboard, auto-updates daily
winningClaim.description:
Live hosted dashboard (opens in any browser, nothing to run): https://swiftbotlab.github.io/poidh-daily-txs/

Transactions per day on the 3 poidh v3 contracts: Ethereum 0xE731dFadBFf20542E10D09D26Fc71445C70d4232, Arbitrum and Base 0x5555Fa783936C260f77385b4E153B9725feF1719. History from Jan 1, 2026 (v3 went live Jan 20 on Base and Arbitrum, May 14 on Ethereum) to today: 7,139 transactions so far.

Updates itself every day at 00:20 UTC: a GitHub Action rebuilds the counts from poidh's indexer and redeploys the page. Stacked bars by chain, daily or weekly, 30 days / 90 days / since Jan 1, hover details, full table and CSV download.

Code and data: https://github.com/swiftbotlab/poidh-daily-txs
